Question Choices: Two ropes measure 506 cm and 759 cm. What is the longest equal integer length, in cm, into which both can be cut with no waste? Use Euclidean division.
Hints: Use the smallest exponent of each prime shared by all the numbers.
Solution: 506 = 2*11*23; 759 = 3*11*23. Taking the common prime factors with their smallest exponents gives GCD = 253.
